text: The spectral radius rho(W_rec) of a reservoir is defined as:
choices: the largest singular value of W_rec
the largest absolute value among the (possibly complex) eigenvalues of W_rec
the average absolute value of the entries of W_rec
the sum of the absolute eigenvalues of W_rec
explanation: By definition rho(W_rec) = max_i |lambda_i|, the maximum modulus over the eigenvalues (complex ones come in conjugate pairs, so rho is real and nonnegative). The largest singular value is the spectral NORM ||W_rec||_2 (a different, larger quantity for non-normal matrices); an entry average and an eigenvalue sum are unrelated to rho.
